description: Read the SPECULATE RECORDS, or list the acknowledgements one wallet holds, which is a signed read that only that wallet can make. view disclosure: the plain-words holding disclosure with its version and the hash an acknowledgement must name. view forward_counts: how many open nonbinding work interests there are per kind of work, place and quarter, never a wallet. recordId: one record of either kind, with its status and why (an interest is shown without its wallet and no withdrawal reason is ever shown). wallet: the acknowledgements one wallet holds, oldest first, which is a signed read that only that wallet can make (interests are never listed by wallet). To list by wallet, call with the wallet alone to get MESSAGE_TO_SIGN, sign it with that wallet (personal_sign, free, no gas), then call again with the wallet, the nonce and the signature within 5 minutes: a signature is good for one list, and a request without a valid one is refused the same way for every wallet. With nothing passed, the disclosure is read. The programs are held off until the operator switches the NET programs on together, and until then the disclosure and the counts say so plainly; this tool moves no NET, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing through it. Every answer says a record is never needed to hold NET, claim a job, vote or work. Free; the disclosure, the counts and a read by id are keyless, and a list by wallet is signed by the holder's own wallet, never by a key. Cost and signer: free; a read by id is keyless, a list by wallet is signed by that wallet itself with no gas, and the house never holds a key.

nonce.description: With wallet: the time in milliseconds the list is signed at, within 5 minutes of the board's time. The first answer gives you one; pass the same number back with the signature.

recordId.description: One record's id (the recordId it was made under). A read by id is keyless: nothing to sign.

signature.description: With wallet and nonce: the 0x… personal_sign output over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN, made by that same wallet. Good for one list.

view.description: disclosure: the words an acknowledgement names. forward_counts: open interests per kind, place and quarter.

wallet.description: Or the 0x… address of a holder, to list its acknowledgements. A list by wallet is a signed read: call with the wallet alone to get MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Address only, never a private key.

name: net_speculate_status
title: Read the holding disclosure, the open work interest counts, one record, or the acknowledgements one wallet holds (a signed read)
